name: Sparse Voxel DAG Construction with Subtree Caching
aliases: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) and DAG Compression
definition: A method to compress a 3D voxel grid into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) by detecting and merging identical subtrees/nodes, reusing existing nodes instead of creating new ones for identical structures.
summary: Sparse Voxel DAG Construction with Subtree Caching compresses 3D voxel grids into a Directed Acyclic Graph by merging identical subtrees, reducing memory usage compared to standard Sparse Voxel Octrees.
